[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Fiorung... Can I talk to you[XENO:n ]
about something?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Shulk told me you remember being[XENO:n ]
inside that Machine God Soldier.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Is it true?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Yes, I remember it all too well.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Someone else was controlling[XENO:n ]
my body, but I was conscious.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I could see, hear and smell.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Then...do you know what that[XENO:n ]
metal-faced Machine God Soldier did to me?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]He killed your father.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Yes. And when my father died,[XENO:n ]
I realised something.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]He loved me dearly. But I found[XENO:n ]
that out much too late.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:sel sel=・And you regret that?/・Why tell me this now? ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]I would be lying if I said no.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But I still have not come to terms[XENO:n ]
with all that has happened.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I do not know how I truly feel.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]I can imagine. It must be[XENO:n ]
very tough.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

It is.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]At the time, all I could think[XENO:n ]
about was killing that Mechon...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]And you don't feel that way now?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

I cannot say for certain.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Sometimes I feel myself becoming[XENO:n ]
enraged when I recall that day.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But the rage is not as potent[XENO:n ]
as it was then.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:sel sel=・How come?/・That's probably for the best. ][XENO:del del=this ]

How can I put this?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]It was seeing that madman die[XENO:n ]
that opened my eyes to it all.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Why? What went through your[XENO:n ]
head the moment Mumca died?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]Up till that very second, I was[XENO:n ]
filled with rage. Then I changed.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Suddenly I felt...pity for him.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
You felt sorry for him?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]He was driven by his obsession[XENO:n ]
with the Monado.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]To be more precise, it stemmed[XENO:n ]
from his jealousy of Dunban.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]He sacrificed his body and mind[XENO:n ]
and it eventually led to his death.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]I see.[XENO:n ]
That's how it was.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I don't know much about Mumca's[XENO:n ]
relationship with my older brother.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Something must have happened[XENO:n ]
for that guy to change so much.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]I do not think anyone remains who[XENO:n ]
can answer all these questions.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]That in itself is what made[XENO:n ]
me realise...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Nothing good can[XENO:n ]
come from revenge.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT3 ]I agree. And you know...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Even if it's still difficult to come to[XENO:n ]
terms with, you've made a start.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]And I am glad I have.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]In some twisted way, I have that[XENO:n ]
man's death to thank for it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Fiorung... Thank you for[XENO:n ]
listening to me.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Don't thank me. I learnt more from[XENO:n ]
you than you did from me![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And I like talking with you anyway.[XENO:n ]
Thanks, Melia.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]I suppose so...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Before, vengeance was all[XENO:n ]
I could think of.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But I realised it would lead[XENO:n ]
to nothing good.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]What changed?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]It was something[XENO:n ]
Shulk said to me.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And what he did, too.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Shulk risked his own life to[XENO:n ]
stop Dunban from killing him.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]Shulk stopped my older brother? But[XENO:n ]
he's bigger and stronger.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Shulk is growing day by day![XENO:n ]
You'll notice that soon enough.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]And that's why you realised[XENO:n ]
killing Mumca was wrong?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Yes. And the others realised too.[XENO:n ]
Shulk changed us all...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Shulk can have a powerful[XENO:n ]
effect on people.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Melia...can we make a pact?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I want us to keep sharing all these[XENO:n ]
things we don't know.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]That is a lovely idea.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Ask me anything, and I will ask[XENO:n ]
you anything as well.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT3 ]Thanks, Melia! Hanging out[XENO:n ]
will be fun![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]I do not know.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But...I am unsure how I should[XENO:n ]
deal with these emotions.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Why not look inside yourself?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]My older brother always tells me that.[XENO:n ]
Search your own feelings first.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]That is sage advice.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I hope it will help me find[XENO:n ]
the answer I am looking for.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I hope so too, Melia.[XENO:n ]
And you know what?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]You probably already have the[XENO:n ]
answer! You just don't know it yet.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:type type=think ][XENO:jaw jaw=off ]I might...already have[XENO:n ]
the answer?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:sel sel=・Has that helped at all?/・I expect you need more time. ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]Yes. I simply needed a push in[XENO:n ]
the right direction. Thank you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

If you don't mind telling me, I'd[XENO:n ]
love to know what you figured out.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I do not mind at all. This is[XENO:n ]
what I realised...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I must never let anyone else[XENO:n ]
experience the pain that I have.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]The pain of losing a parent?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]Not just that.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I wish to build a world free of war,[XENO:n ]
where no one must risk their lives.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]That's very ambitious, Melia.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Do you really think you can do it?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]It will not be easy, and I cannot[XENO:n ]
do it alone.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]But I will be Achamoth's next ruler.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]If I do not take up this challenge,[XENO:n ]
who will?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT3 ]You're amazing, Melia. You don't[XENO:n ]
shy from anything.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And if you need any help,[XENO:n ]
I'll be there in an instant.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]We're friends. I'll be there for you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Thank you. Your words[XENO:n ]
give me confidence.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Leave it to little old Fiorung![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And don't worry! I'll drag Shulk[XENO:n ]
and Rein along to help as well![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]Yes. I sense that the answer is[XENO:n ]
trapped somewhere inside of me.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]I hate it when that happens.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]But I feel I may be close to[XENO:n ]
figuring it out.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I know the feeling. Like it's on the[XENO:n ]
tip of your tongue, right?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But you can't force it.[XENO:n ]
You'll never find it that way.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

You speak with wisdom, Fiorung.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I agree. The answer will come to[XENO:n ]
me on its own.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]All I need is patience.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT3 ]That's the spirit![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Thank you, Fiorung. You have[XENO:n ]
reassured me a great deal.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Would you mind if I continued[XENO:n ]
to confide in you from now on?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT3 ]You don't even need to ask![XENO:n ]
It would be my pleasure, Melia.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
